title: Lamb and Thai Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb curry inspired by the spices of Thailand. This gluten-free dish is perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb
ingredients.amount: 1.5 pounds boneless leg, cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: 1. Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
2. Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
3. Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
4. Add the coconut milk, curry sauce, fish sauce, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, for 20 minutes.
6. Season the curry with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve over rice or noodles.
